completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4651_1966.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barrios of Maligaya, Kawit, Malusak, Balite, Dalagan, Tinalunan, Calamundingan, Bulbogan, Langang, Banus, Agus, Batingan, Papandungin, Malamig, Tubag, Malayong, Malubay, Mirayan, Guimbonan, Agsalin, Manguyang, Banutan, Boong-Lupa, Tambong, and Maragooc in the Municipality of Pinamalayan, Province of Oriental Mindoro, are separated from said municipality, and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality, to be known as the Municipality of Gloria, same province. The seat of government of the new municipality shall be in the present site of the barrio of Maligaya.
The first officials of the Municipality of Gloria shall be elected in the general elections of the year nineteen hundred sixty-seven.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 9, 1966.
